definitions.explanation: A duration of six months. The standard expression for a half-year period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}だ。
examples.english: The study-abroad period is six months.

examples.japanese: ⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Six months have passed since then.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試用期間|しようきかん}→試用期間：15675_shiyoukikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}え→終える：02019_oeru⟧、⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Having completed the six-month trial period without issue, I was hired as a permanent employee.

notes:
⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ (six) + ヶ{月|げつ} (months counter), with sokuon assimilation to ろっ before ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧.

WRITING VARIANTS:
The middle character can be written as ヶ, ヵ, ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, カ, or {箇|か} — all read ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧:
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ} (most common in print)
- {六|ろっ}{箇月|かげつ} (formal/legal)
- {六|ろっ}か{月|げつ} (informal)

The small ヶ is the standard learner-facing form. Note that this ヶ is not a katakana 'ke' but an abbreviation of {箇|か}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧: for a six-month period
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: six months ago
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: six months later
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧: within six months

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧: half a year — equivalent in duration, more idiomatic in casual speech
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ヶ{月|げつ}: three months
- ⟦{十二|じゅうに}→十二：00952_juuni⟧ヶ{月|げつ}: twelve months
